text:
maria: Heads up — multiple GPU node pools failing healthchecks and a bunch of model-pull timeouts in us-west2-edge. ALB is returning 503 for /health and several model-serving pods stuck ImagePullBackOff. Started ~5m ago, saw alert from the runtime dashboard. Any ideas?

sre-bot: ALERT: ingress-us-west2 high_5xx_rate (rule: edge-alb -> target-group: gpu-nodes)

devon: I pulled ALB logs, seeing a lot of `503` and `Client connection aborted` entries. Also NAT gateway shows TCP resets from nodes when connecting out to model-registry. Could be an egress/ingress port issue between ALB and targets. Did anyone touch SGs or NACLs?

amanda: I merged a small TF change earlier to tighten the prod-ingress security group. We reduced allowed source port range for the ALB-target SG to 1024-10240 (previously 1024-65535). The intent was to narrow attack surface for a particular proxy.

kai: That will bite us — ALBs use ephemeral source ports when connecting to targets. Health checks and target responses expect the full ephemeral range (1024-65535). Shortening it will cause asymmetric drops/backoffs. Quick remediation is to re-open ephemeral ports on the SG/NACL for the edge subnets.

maria: Can we hotfix that? I need the GPU pods healthy to finish a rollout.

amanda: Pushing a revert now — re-adding `from_port = 1024` `to_port = 65535` in the SG rule and will add a NACL entry to allow ephemeral range for the edge subnet. Applying infra/edge-hotfix PR.

devon: For folks running CLI, this is the command to add the SG rule temporarily:

```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0abc12345 --protocol tcp --port 1024-65535 --source-security-group-id sg-alb-edge
```

And NACL patch (aws):
```
aws ec2 create-network-acl-entry --network-acl-id acl-0def456 --rule-number 100 --protocol tcp --port-range From=1024,To=65535 --egress false --rule-action allow --cidr-block 10.0.0.0/16
```

kai: We should also avoid relying on ephemeral port NUMERICS in PRs; add a comment linking to ALB behaviour.

amanda: Apply finished — infra job succeeded. Reverted the SG change and added the NACL entry for subnets: subnet-edge-a/b/c. Rolling restart the target group now.

maria: Confirming: pods are coming back up. ImagePullBackOff rates dropping, LB healthchecks moving from 60% -> 98% healthy. Still watching for a couple flakes. Thanks!! :tada:

ops-rotation: I'll keep monitoring for the next 30m and mark as incident resolved if stable. Please file a short postmortem with root cause (tightened SG) and a follow-up to add CI test/PR template note.

devon: Filed INFRA-432: "Prevent accidental ephemeral port tightenings on ALB->target SGs" with suggested CI test + PR checklist.

amanda: I'll write the postmortem and include the PR link + revert diff. Also adding an infra-lint rule to warn when a SG change shrinks 1024-65535 on an ALB-related SG.

maria: Great — closing signal incoming in 20m, will ping if anything resurfaces.
